title: 1.2.15 Greeting with Backticks
description: Build a greeting with a template literal, then prove single quotes cannot do the same job. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Declare myName
steps.instructions: Declare a variable called `myName` and set it to your name in quotes.

steps.title: Greet with a template literal
steps.instructions: Log a greeting using backticks, embedding myName with ${...}.

steps.title: Embed a calculation too
steps.instructions: In the same greeting or a second one, embed a calculation such as ${2024 + 1}.

steps.title: Now try it with single quotes
steps.instructions: Log the same text again using single quotes instead of backticks. Read both outputs and note the difference.

requirements.title: A calculation is embedded
requirements.description: Embeds an expression containing an operator, such as ${2024 + 1}
